sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER They are heard. Perused the case-diary.

This is the first bail application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code,
1973 as he/she is implicated in connection with Crime No.205/2022 registered at Police Station - Nilwali District - Barwani (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(3), 342,
343 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 31/08/2022.

sentences.text: The allegation against the applicant is of abduction and rape.

Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case only at the instance of the family members of the prosecutrix, despite the fact that she in her initial statement given to the police has clearly given clean chit to the applicant.

Counsel for the applicant has drawn the attention of this Court to the Roznamcha of Police Station Niwali, District Barwani dated 17.08.2022, wherein the Police have recorded that after the prosecutrix was recovered she has stated that she had left her house on her own after dispute in family and had resided with her friend Shraddha and no untoward incident has happened with her.
Counsel for the applicant has also submitted that the applicant is suffering from 40% disability.
His disability certificate is also placed on record.
Thus, it is submitted that the applicant, who is lodged in jail since 31.08.2022 and the charge-sheet has already been filed, deserves to be released on bail.
Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed and it is submitted that the age of the prosecutrix is stated to be 13 years and 11 months.
Thus, no case for grant of bail is made out.

O n due consideration of submissions and on perusal of the case-diary and the charge-sheet, which is available with the counsel for the applicant, this Court finds force with the contentions raised by the counsel for the applicant.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on merits of the matter, the present application for grant of bail is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his/her appearance, as and when directed and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
C.c. as per rules.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE Pankaj Rahul Rathore vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44815080/
